summary: Frontend-only UI testing for /dashboard/me account dashboard. Tested all 6 tabs (Profile, Addresses, Notifications, Security, Billing, Activity), sidebar Profile link, deep-link ?tab=security, Logout flow with confirmation + localStorage clear + /login redirect, Delete-account DELETE-typed gating, password strength + mismatch + success-clear, sessions sign-out individual + sign-out-others, login history 5 rows, 2FA toggle, address CRUD + set-default + persistence + distinct delete dialog, notifications toggles + saved indicator + LS persistence, billing card + payment methods + invoices + coupons, activity stats, responsive 375px pill bar, sidebar profile-card name reflects saved profile. 100% of the spec checklist passes end-to-end via Playwright at production URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Account.jsx tabs render BOTH the mobile horizontal pill bar (lg:hidden) AND the desktop vertical nav with identical data-testid='account-tab-{id}-btn'. Duplicate testids in the DOM hurt automated test reliability — at >=lg the mobile copy is display:none but still in the DOM. Suggest distinct testids (e.g. add suffix '-mobile' / '-desktop') OR conditionally render rather than dual-render. Tests must currently use .locator(visible=true).first to disambiguate.

NotificationsTab.useEffect calls saveNotifications + setSavedAt on every render of prefs — including the initial mount (which writes the seed back). That's fine functionally but causes the 'Saved' indicator to flash on first render even before the user interacted. Minor UX nit.

ProfileTab fileToDataUrl is imported from '@/lib/bookingPersistence' — slight coupling between Account and Booking. Consider moving fileToDataUrl into a shared util like '@/lib/files' to avoid the cross-feature import.

BillingTab invoice rows render correctly but don't expose a per-invoice data-testid like 'billing-invoice-{id}'. Spec lists 'billing-*' in testid coverage; tests can grep on INV- text but a row-level testid would be more robust for future regressions.

SecurityTab.jsx is 645 lines and houses 5 sub-sections + 2 dialogs. Under the >700-line guideline today, but moving these subsections into /components/account/security/*.jsx files (PasswordSection, SessionsSection, LoginHistory, TwoFactor, DangerZone) would help maintainability.

clearAllUserData in accountStorage.js does NOT clear bincycle:cookie-consent — by design (the consent banner shouldn't re-prompt). This matches the spec wording ('clears all bincycle:* keys' colloquially, with consent excluded). Document this in a code comment so future contributors don't 'fix' it.

2FA toggle state is component-local useState — not persisted. If the spec intends 2FA to look 'enabled' after reload, hook it into accountStorage. Currently spec says 'placeholder' so this is acceptable.
TwoFactorSection toast text uses toast() generic for the 'off' case instead of toast.success/info — minor inconsistency vs other tabs which use toast.success.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 17 spec checklist items verified passing

test_credentials: N/A — auth pages stubbed; preview app accepts /dashboard/me without auth.
seed_data_creation: Cleared all bincycle:* localStorage keys before each major flow. Created one new address (Work, 560001) and deleted it; persistence verified across reloads. Edited profile to 'Test QA User' / 'qa@test.com' and verified sidebar profile-card text reflects it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All required data-testids verified present and functional: sidebar-link-profile, sidebar-signout (logout trigger), sidebar-profile-name (or sidebar aside contains the saved name), account-page, account-settings-nav, account-tab-{profile,addresses,notifications,security,billing,activity}-btn (NOTE: duplicated mobile+desktop — use .locator(visible=true).first in tests), account-tab-content, profile-edit-btn, profile-input-{name,email,phone}, profile-save-btn, profile-cancel-btn, profile-display-name, profile-avatar-upload-btn, profile-avatar-input, address-add-btn, address-add-form, address-form-{label,line1,city,pincode}, address-form-save-btn, address-form-cancel-btn, address-item-{id}, address-default-badge-{id}, address-set-default-{id}, address-edit-{id}, address-delete-{id}, address-delete-dialog, address-delete-cancel, address-delete-confirm, addresses-list, addresses-empty, notifications-row-{key}, notifications-toggle-{email,sms,reminders,marketing}, notifications-saved-indicator, security-section-{password,sessions,history,2fa,danger}, security-password-{form,current,new,confirm,toggle,submit}, security-strength, security-sessions-list, session-row-{id}, session-signout-{id} (NOT present for s_current), security-signout-others, security-login-history, login-row-{l1..l5}, security-2fa-state, security-2fa-toggle, security-delete-account-btn, delete-account-dialog, delete-account-input, delete-account-cancel-btn, delete-account-confirm-btn (disabled until input==='DELETE' case-sensitive trimmed). LogoutDialog: logout-dialog, logout-cancel-btn, logout-confirm-btn. clearAllUserData clears bincycle:profile, addresses, notifications, sessions, booking:draft, pickups (does NOT clear bincycle:cookie-consent — intentional). Logout + delete-account both navigate to /login. Deep link /dashboard/me?tab=security works. 375px viewport shows lg:hidden pill bar (verified). Two distinct dialogs (address-delete-dialog vs delete-account-dialog) correctly separated. NOTE for future agents: there is NO per-invoice testid like 'billing-invoice-{id}' — match INV- text instead.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found in this iteration. Single duplicated-testid observation is a maintainability concern not a functional bug — both copies render the same content under the same component instance; only one is visible per viewport class via Tailwind lg:hidden / hidden lg:flex.
